text_block_list.text:
All of Симболи Рудольф's races have been
run. She
has carried the dreams of every
Umamusume on
her back and engraved
the Emperor's name into
the heart of all
who watched her race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The words of gratitude she exchanges
with me
ring all the sweeter for our
shared efforts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
